# Find the free signups that are about to become customers.

> A free, open-source alternative to MadKudu and Pocus for small SaaS: learn from your own signups which first-week behaviour comes before paying, with an honest out-of-time accuracy check. Paste an export and try it in your browser first.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
